posts.text: According to Bloomberg, Israel's David's Sling air defense system can now intercept a wider set of ballistic missiles at greater range following an upgrade. The system relies on the Stunner interceptor, which costs about $1 million, roughly one-third the price of an Arrow 3 and under a quarter of a U.S. Patriot PAC-3.

EXO အဖွဲ့ခေါင်းဆောင်အား New Year ပွဲအတွက် မင်းအောင်လှိုင်သမီး၏ ကုမ္ပဏီ ဖိတ်မှု ဝိုင်း ကန့်ကွက် သတင်း | ယုဖြူဟန်၊ နိုဝင်ဘာ ၂၀၊ ၂၀၂၆ အာဏာသိမ်းသမ္မတ မင်းအောင်လှိုင်သမီး ခင်သီရိသက်မွန်၏ ရုပ်ရှင်ကုမ္ပဏီ Shwe Nadi Shwe Yi က တောင်ကိုရီးယား နာမည်ကြီး K-pop ဖြစ်သော EXOအဖွဲ့ ခေါင်းဆောင် SUHO အား ၂၀၂၇ New Year ပွဲကို မြန်မာ၌ လာရောက်ဖျော်ဖြေရန် ဖိတ်ခေါ်ထားသည့်အပေါ် ပရိသက်များက လူမှုကွန်ရက်မှတဆင့် ပြင်းပြင်းထန်ထန် ကန့်ကွက်နေကြသည်။ နိုဝင်ဘာ ၁၈ရက်က Shwe Nadi Shwe Yi ရုပ်ရှင်ထုတ်လုပ်ရေးက ၂၀၂၇ နှစ်သစ်ကူးအထူးဖျော်ဖြေပွဲ SUHO ကို ဖိတ်၍ ဂီတဖျော်ဖြေမှုများ၊ အမှတ်တရအစီအစဉ်များဖြင့် ကျင်းပသွားမည်ဟု ကြေညာရာ မြန်မာ့လက်ရှိ နိုင်ငံရေးအခြေအနေ ကြောင့် မလာသင့်ကြောင်း EXO-L မြန်မာပရိသတ်များက ဝေဖန် ကန့်ကွက်နေခြင်း ဖြစ်သည်။ Exo ပရိသတ်တဦးက “ပွဲစီစဉ်တဲ့ သူက မအလသမီး၊ Suho သာဒီကို လာရင် သူလည်း အောင်ဇမ္ဗူ နဲ့ မခြားတဲ့အဆင့် တခုကို ရောက်သွားလိမ့်မယ်။ ဒီပွဲကို Boycott ရမှာပါ။ Suho ရော EXO ရော တဘဝလုံး အာဏာရှင် အားပေးဖြစ်တော့မှာ။ ဒီပွဲရဲ့လက်မှတ်ဖိုးတွေက အညာကို ကြဲမယ့် လေယာဉ်ဆီဖိုးတွေဆိုတာ သတိရကြပါဦး” ဟု ပြောသည်။ Website တွင် ဖတ်ရန် https://burma.irrawaddy.com/news/2026/11/20/417746.html #WhatsHappeningInMyanmar --------------------- စာဖတ်သူများ၏ ပံ့ပိုးမှုက ပြည်သူများ လိုအပ်နေသည့် အကောင်းဆုံး နှင့် အရည်အသွေးမီ သတင်းများကို ဖော်ပြစေနိုင်မည်။ Support The Irrawaddy: https://www.irrawaddy.com/donation

Do Not Let a Stereotype Define Manhood Dear sister, look carefully before you judge all men by the image of the worst among them. Among men are scholars who stand as fortresses of Islam, preserving knowledge, faith, and truth. Among them are those who struggle and sacrifice to protect their communities from the plots and aggression of their enemies. Among them are students of knowledge, pursuing learning in its many fields with patience and dedication. Among them are also the hardworking men who spend their days beneath the burning sun or in the bitter cold of winter, exhausting their bodies to earn lawful sustenance for their wives, children, and families. They sacrifice their time, strength, comfort, and even their sleep so that those entrusted to their care may live with dignity. Some carry such heavy burdens that they fall asleep in their chairs, deprived of the rest their bodies desperately need because of the pressures of life. Yet a distorted image of manhood is increasingly promoted—one that encourages women to see themselves as being in a permanent war against men and male authority. Such a narrative erases all these righteous examples and reduces manhood to the image of the tyrant, the cruel oppressor, the heartless husband, the father who weaponizes children against a divorced mother, the irresponsible womanizer, or the corrupt and violent man who abuses women. Yes, there are corrupt and abusive men; their oppression must never be justified, but justice requires discernment. Your responsibility is to choose carefully: Do not choose a corrupt man and then condemn all men. Do not choose cruelty and then curse marriage, family, and life itself. Choose the righteous over the corrupt, responsibility over recklessness, mercy over cruelty, and faith over empty appearances. For the Qur’an reminds us: “Allah is the Guardian of those who believe.” (Qur’an 2:257) So choose with faith, wisdom, and awareness—and trust that the One who knows what is hidden can guide you toward what is good.

Israel has upgraded its David’s Sling air defense system to counter a wider range of Iranian ballistic missiles at lower cost. Its Stunner interceptors cost about $1 million each, compared with $3 million for Arrow 3 and more than $4 million for U.S. Patriot PAC-3 missiles. The upgrade follows Iranian strikes that exposed gaps in Israel’s defenses and strained interceptor supplies. Source: Bloomberg

BIG: A Russian Kh-101 cruise missile crashed in a field near Nowy Lipowiec in Poland’s Lublin region earlier today during a large Russian missile and drone attack on Ukraine. Polish Defense Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz confirmed the incident. The missile came down roughly 45–60 km from the Ukrainian border, leaving a crater and burning debris, with no casualties or damage to critical infrastructure reported. Kosiniak-Kamysz said a second site was also consistent with a missile and a third was most likely a jet-powered drone. Other locations under investigation include Mołodycz and Rudnik nad Sanem in Podkarpackie. It is the second confirmed Kh-101 to land in Poland this year, after one flew about 95 km into the country on 30 July. Polish military prosecutors are investigating how many objects entered Polish airspace, and Prime Minister Donald Tusk said there is no ongoing air threat.
